merchant_hub_text_50: We originally designed DiEtalase to be entirely free, but we quickly discovered that zero cost leads to zero commitment. When there is nothing at stake, platforms suffer from abandoned digital storefronts—products are left unupdated, inventory is neglected, and customer inquiries go unanswered.
merchant_hub_text_51: By charging a predictable, low-cost flat fee, we ensure a high-quality marketplace:
merchant_hub_text_52: Every merchant on our map is a real, dedicated business actively managing their products.
merchant_hub_text_53: Sellers who invest in their platform are highly motivated to answer your chats and fulfill orders quickly.
merchant_hub_text_54: Eliminates spam, fake listings, and dead stores, keeping the hyper-local community reliable for everyone.
merchant_hub_text_55: Infrastructure That Does The Heavy Lifting
merchant_hub_text_57: You just focus on making your products. When a customer buys from your shop and another nearby store at the same time, our app automatically groups them into one smart delivery trip. This slashes shipping costs for the buyer and gets your items out the door without any manual hassle.
merchant_hub_text_58: No Paid Favorites, Just Real Visibility
merchant_hub_text_59: Giant e-commerce apps let massive corporations pay money to hide small shops like yours. DiEtalase doesn't do that. Our app works strictly by distance. If a local buyer is searching for items within 15km, they will see your shop clearly. Everyone gets the exact same fair chance.
merchant_hub_text_61: You don't need to be a tech genius to sell here. Easily keep track of your stock, see what items your neighbors are buying the most, and handle different product choices (like sizes or colors) through a clean, fast app designed to save you time.
